description.value: Canco Gas & One Stop Convenience is a combined fuel station and convenience store on Westsyde Road in the north end of Kamloops. Operating under the Canco banner, it positions itself as a single-stop destination for road travellers needing fuel, snacks, and convenience items. For cyclists riding the Westsyde corridor or heading toward Clearwater, it represents a practical resupply point in a stretch with limited services.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record tags this as both amenity=fuel and shop=convenience, confirming it is a gas station with an attached convenience store; the name 'One Stop Convenience' further corroborates a multi-service stop. The website (Facebook page) returned only Facebook's bot-block error pages on all subpages, yielding no usable business content — all amenity claims must rely on OSM tags alone. No OSM tags address bike parking, water, washrooms, or other cyclist-specific amenities, so those remain null.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, operating gas station and convenience store on an active cycling corridor in Kamloops; clearly useful to touring cyclists as a fuel and resupply stop.
